```yaml
name: Social Copy Generator

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [edited]

jobs:
  social-copy:
    if: github.event.issue.pull_request != null
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
      contents: write
      actions: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
      CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Post initial comment
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'opened' }}
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ### 📢 Social Copy Generator
            - [ ] Generate social media copies
          comment-tag: social-copy-generator
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.number }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          create-if-not-exists: true

      - name: Detect checkbox checked
        if: |
          ${{ github.event_name == 'issue_comment' &&
             github.event.action == 'edited' &&
             contains(github.event.comment.body, 'social-copy-generator') &&
             contains(github.event.comment.body, '[x]') &&
             github.event.comment.user.login == github.actor }}
        id: detect
        run: echo "checkbox_checked=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Update comment to Generating...
        if: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.checkbox_checked == 'true' }}
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ### 📢 Social Copy Generator
            Generating...
          comment-tag: social-copy-generator
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          create-if-not-exists: false

      - name: Run Claude Code
        if: ${{ steps.detect.outputs.checkbox_checked == 'true' }}
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          prompt: |
            Analyze the diff of the pull request and generate social media copies for:
            1. Twitter/X
            2. LinkedIn
            3. Blog Post
            Return the result in JSON format with keys `twitter`, `linkedin`, `blog`.
        id: claude

      - name: Build comment content
        if: ${{ success() }}
        id: build
        run: |
          echo "twitter=$(echo '${{ steps.claude.outputs.structured_output }}' | jq -r .twitter)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "linkedin=$(echo '${{ steps.claude.outputs.structured_output }}' | jq -r .linkedin)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "blog=$(echo '${{ steps.claude.outputs.structured_output }}' | jq -r .blog)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Update comment with results
        if: ${{ success() }}
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ### 📢 Social Copy Generator
            **Twitter/X**  
            ${{ steps.build.outputs.twitter }}

            **LinkedIn**  
            ${{ steps.build.outputs.linkedin }}

            **Blog Post**  
            ${{ steps.build.outputs.blog }}

            - [ ] Regenerate
          comment-tag: social-copy-generator
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          create-if-not-exists: false

      - name: Update comment on failure
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            ### 📢 Social Copy Generator
            ❌ Error generating social copies.  
            See [workflow logs](${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}) for details.  
            - [ ] Regenerate
          comment-tag: social-copy-generator
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          create-if-not-exists: false
```
